purpose: provide the documentation developers need to understand, build, run, change and operate the system, and keep it correct as the code changes
entry_criteria: The system and its repositories exist
A docs location under version control exists
procedure: Start from the tasks developers perform: set up, run tests, make a change, debug, release and handle an incident, and write a page for each.
Make every command copy-pasteable and test them on a clean environment, recording the versions assumed.
Generate reference documentation from the code (API specs, configuration tables) so it cannot drift, and write by hand only the explanations.
Keep docs in the repository and change them in the same pull request as the code, with a review checklist item.
Check the docs in CI with link checks, command checks and spelling, and give each page an owner and a review date.
Measure usefulness through onboarding time and questions asked in chat, and fix the pages behind repeated questions.
acceptance_criteria: Commands were run on a clean environment
Reference docs are generated from code
Docs change in the same pull request as behavior
Each page has an owner and review date

validation.check: a new developer follows the setup guide on a clean machine and notes the first failure
validation.expect: setup completes, or the failure is fixed in the guide

failure_modes.response: Fix and test on a clean machine

worked_example: ILLUSTRATIVE: The setup guide is followed on a clean laptop and fails at a missing environment variable. The guide is corrected, the API reference is generated from the OpenAPI file, and a CI check blocks broken links.
